subject.title: Node host: no SSH transport support + challenge auth fails behind reverse proxy

question: Should `openclaw node run` gain first-class managed SSH transport, and what approval behavior should remote or reverse-proxied node-host connections use?
rationale: The answer changes SSH process ownership, node service persistence, token selection, and whether tunneled or proxied node clients receive local/trusted pairing treatment.

options.title: Define and implement managed remote node-host contract
options.body: Keep this issue open, coordinate the auth overlap with #91126, and require live managed-tunnel or reverse-proxy proof before closing.

options.title: Split transport from auth policy
options.body: Track managed SSH transport separately and narrow this issue to current-main reverse-proxy pairing/auth reproduction and repair.

options.title: Keep manual SSH as supported path
options.body: Close only after maintainers explicitly decide not to manage node-host SSH in core and update docs or diagnostics to steer users to manual tunnels.

recommendation.title: Define and implement managed remote node-host contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, coordinate the auth overlap with #91126, and require live managed-tunnel or reverse-proxy proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to this owner for node-host runtime, SSH helper, and gateway handshake boundaries.
